object_description: school complex of scattered volumes around a central square
design_condition: The existing building remains central within an east-west playground, while new volumes line the square and a surrounding green belt responds to the sloping topography and connects the complex to the district.

positive.statement: The proposal demonstrates a strong spatial idea and a precise urban setting of the buildings within the designed landscape.

position.rationale: Scattered volumes visibly frame a central open area across the top and elevation projections.

positive.statement: The composition balances actively and passively usable spaces and creates atmospheric tension between built and natural open space.

position.rationale: Central open space and separated building footprints are directly visible in the top view.

positive.statement: The approach creates an extremely independent identity and transforms the site into an important open space for the district.

position.rationale: A clearly open central zone is enclosed by scattered volumes in the top projection.

positive.statement: Despite the challenging topography, almost barrier-free access to all areas is offered.

position.rationale: Accessibility applies across the clustered complex; no ramps or barriers are individually identifiable.

positive.statement: The volumetric formation incorporates the scale and qualities of the existing building.

position.rationale: Multiple offset volumes with varied heights are clearly visible in top and elevation views.

positive.statement: The organization and distribution of uses are well thought out and largely correspond to the client's ideas.

position.rationale: Uses are internal and unmarked; the anchor covers the distributed building cluster.

positive.statement: The planned phases enable seamless school operations.

position.rationale: Phasing and operational continuity have no identifiable geometric location in the sampled model.

positive.statement: The construction allows simple adjustments as user needs change and supports sustainability through material and structural robustness.

position.rationale: Structural adaptability concerns the clustered building system rather than a distinguishable exterior element.

positive.statement: The clear operational arrangement of the teaching areas enables three clusters and usable corridor areas.

position.rationale: Teaching clusters are approximated within the upper portions of the distributed volumes.

positive.statement: The arrangement of the auditorium, library, care and specialist rooms enables autonomous extracurricular use.

position.target: auditorium, library, care and specialist rooms
position.rationale: Specialist and communal uses are assigned to a representative lower-level volume without interior visibility.

negative.statement: The chosen facade cladding is not convincing in terms of expression and sustainability.

position.rationale: Exterior facade surfaces are visible, though material cladding is not distinguishable from sampled points.

negative.statement: The formal design of the entrance canopies is not yet convincing.

position.rationale: Entrance edges are approximated along the southern frontage; canopies are not separately visible.

negative.statement: The internal development and organization are not yet convincing; access to the sports hall appears narrow and committed only to functionality.

position.rationale: Sports access is assigned to a lower-level edge zone, without a distinguishable hall entrance.

negative.statement: The location of the bicycle shelter must be reconsidered because of its distance from the road and restrictions on civil-defense-system usability.

position.rationale: The shelter is approximated near the western edge and road-facing side, but is absent as a distinct feature.

negative.statement: The long-term relocation of the kindergarten would affect operations that still need clarification.

position.rationale: Kindergarten operations are assigned to a representative lower-level volume without identifiable room geometry.

negative.statement: The environmental design remains somewhat schematic and requires more differentiated elaboration.

position.rationale: The central square and surrounding open areas are visible, while landscape differentiation is not represented.

negative.statement: The renovation work and its impact on the continued usability of the civil-defense facility still need to be proven.

position.rationale: The facility is not identifiable; a lower-level anchor is assigned within the eastern building cluster.
